verses.kjv: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
verses.modern: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called as an apostle, set apart for the gospel of God—

verses.kjv: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)
verses.modern: which He promised beforehand through His prophets in the holy scriptures—

verses.kjv: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;
verses.modern: concerning His Son, Jesus Christ our Lord, who was descended from David according to the flesh,

verses.kjv: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
verses.modern: and declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead.

verses.kjv: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:
verses.modern: Through Him we have received grace and apostleship to bring about obedience of faith among all nations for His name's sake.

verses.kjv: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:
verses.modern: You also are among those who are called by Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: To all in Rome who are beloved of God, called to be saints: grace to You and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
verses.modern: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of You, because Your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

verses.kjv: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
verses.modern: God is my witness — whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of His Son — that without ceasing I mention You always in my prayers,

verses.kjv: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.
verses.modern: asking that somehow, by God's will, I may at last succeed in coming to You.

verses.kjv: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
verses.modern: I long to see You, so that I may share some spiritual gift to strengthen You—

verses.kjv: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.
verses.modern: that is, that we may be mutually encouraged by each other's faith, both Yours and mine.

verses.kjv: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
verses.modern: I do not want You to be unaware, brothers, that I have often intended to come to You but have been hindered until now, so that I might have some fruit among You as well as among the rest of the Gentiles.

verses.kjv: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
verses.modern: I am under obligation both to Greeks and to non-Greeks, both to the wise and to the foolish.

verses.kjv: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
verses.modern: So I am eager to preach the gospel to You also who are in Rome.

verses.kjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.modern: I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ, for it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes — to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

verses.kjv: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
verses.modern: In it the righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith, as it is written: "The just shall live by faith."

verses.kjv: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;
verses.modern: The wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness.

verses.kjv: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.
verses.modern: What can be known about God is plain to them, for God has shown it to them.

verses.kjv: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
verses.modern: His invisible qualities — His eternal power and Godhead — have been clearly seen since the creation of the world, understood through what has been made. So they are without excuse.

verses.kjv: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
verses.modern: Although they knew God, they did not honor Him as God or give thanks to Him. Their thinking became worthless, and their foolish hearts were darkened.

verses.kjv: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
verses.modern: Claiming to be wise, they became fools.

verses.kjv: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.
verses.modern: They exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images made to look like mortal man, birds, four-footed animals, and reptiles.

verses.kjv: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
verses.modern: Therefore God gave them over to the impure desires of their hearts, to dishonoring their bodies among themselves.

verses.kjv: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.modern: They exchanged the truth of God for a lie and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, Who is blessed forever. Amen.

verses.kjv: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:
verses.modern: For this reason God gave them over to vile affections. Even their women exchanged natural relations for those that are contrary to nature.

verses.kjv: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was met.
verses.modern: In the same way the men abandoned natural relations with women and burned with desire for one another. Men committed shameful acts with men and received in themselves the due penalty for their error.

verses.kjv: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;
verses.modern: Since they did not see fit to acknowledge God, He gave them over to a corrupt mind to do things that should not be done.

verses.kjv: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
verses.modern: They are filled with every kind of unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, greed, evil, envy, murder, strife, deceit, and malice. They are gossips,

verses.kjv: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
verses.modern: slanderers, God-haters, insolent, arrogant, and boastful. They invent new forms of evil and disobey their parents.

verses.kjv: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:
verses.modern: They have no sense, break their covenants, have no natural affection, are implacable, and show no mercy.

verses.kjv: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.
verses.modern: Though they know God's decree — that those who do such things deserve death — they not only do them but approve of others who practice them.

chapters.summary: Paul introduces himself and declares that the gospel is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes. He argues that God's wrath is revealed against all ungodliness, because men suppress the truth and worship the creature rather than the Creator, and God gives them over to a reprobate mind.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
verses.modern: Therefore You are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judges. When you judge another, You condemn Yourself, because You who judge do the same things.

verses.kjv: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.
verses.modern: We know that God's judgment against those who do such things is according to truth.

verses.kjv: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
verses.modern: Do You suppose, O man — you who judge those who do such things and yet do them Yourself — that You will escape the judgment of God?

verses.kjv: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
verses.modern: Or do You despise the riches of His goodness, forbearance, and longsuffering, not knowing that God's kindness is meant to lead You to repentance?

verses.kjv: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
verses.modern: But because of Your hard and unrepentant heart You are storing up wrath for Yourself on the day of wrath, when God's righteous judgment will be revealed.

verses.kjv: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
verses.modern: He will repay each person according to what He has done.

verses.kjv: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:
verses.modern: To those who by patient endurance in doing good seek glory, honor, and immortality, He will give eternal life.

verses.kjv: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,
verses.modern: But to those who are self-seeking and do not obey the truth but obey unrighteousness, there will be wrath and fury.

verses.kjv: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;
verses.modern: There will be tribulation and anguish for every soul of man who does evil — for the Jew first and also for the Gentile.

verses.kjv: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
verses.modern: But there will be glory, honor, and peace for everyone who does good — for the Jew first and also for the Gentile.

verses.kjv: For there is no respect of persons with God.
verses.modern: For God shows no partiality.

verses.kjv: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;
verses.modern: All who have sinned without the law will also perish without the law, and all who have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

verses.kjv: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
verses.modern: For it is not the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law who will be justified.

verses.kjv: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
verses.modern: When Gentiles who do not have the law do by nature the things required by the law, they are a law to themselves, even though they do not have the law.

verses.kjv: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
verses.modern: They show that the work of the law is written on their hearts. Their conscience also bears witness, and their thoughts either accuse or defend them.

verses.kjv: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.
verses.modern: This will happen on the day when God judges the secrets of men through Jesus Christ, according to my gospel.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,
verses.modern: Now if You call Yourself a Jew and rely on the law and boast in God—

verses.kjv: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
verses.modern: if You know His will and approve what is excellent because You are instructed from the law—

verses.kjv: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,
verses.modern: if You are confident that You are a guide to the blind, a light to those in darkness,

verses.kjv: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
verses.modern: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of children, having in the law the pattern of knowledge and truth—

verses.kjv: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
verses.modern: you then who teach others — do You not teach Yourself? You who preach against stealing, do You steal?

verses.kjv: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
verses.modern: You who say one should not commit adultery, do You commit adultery? You who hate idols, do You rob temples?

verses.kjv: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
verses.modern: You who boast in the law, do You dishonor God by breaking the law?

verses.kjv: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.
verses.modern: "The name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of You," as it is written.

verses.kjv: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.
verses.modern: Circumcision has value if You obey the law, but if You break the law, Your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

verses.kjv: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
verses.modern: So if a man who is uncircumcised keeps the requirements of the law, will not His uncircumcision be counted as circumcision?

verses.kjv: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?
verses.modern: The one who is physically uncircumcised but keeps the law will judge You who, with Your written code and circumcision, are a lawbreaker.

verses.kjv: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
verses.modern: A person is not a Jew who is one outwardly, nor is circumcision something outward in the flesh.

verses.kjv: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
verses.modern: A person is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the letter. Such a person's praise is not from men but from God.

chapters.summary: Paul argues that the moralist who judges others is equally guilty before God, because God judges impartially according to truth. He warns that the Jew who boasts in the law yet breaks it dishonors God, and that true circumcision is of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the letter.

verses.kjv: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?
verses.modern: What advantage has the Jew? Or what is the value of circumcision?

verses.kjv: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
verses.modern: Much in every way. First, the Jews were entrusted with the oracles of God.

verses.kjv: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
verses.modern: What if some were unfaithful? Does their unfaithfulness cancel out the faithfulness of God?

verses.kjv: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.
verses.modern: Not at all! Let God be true though every man a liar, as it is written: "That you may be justified in Your words, and prevail when You are judged."

verses.kjv: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
verses.modern: But if our unrighteousness highlights the righteousness of God, what shall we say? That God is unrighteous in bringing His wrath? I am speaking in human terms.

verses.kjv: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
verses.modern: Not at all! For then how could God judge the world?

verses.kjv: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
verses.modern: But if through my lie God's truth abounds to His glory, why am I still condemned as a sinner?

verses.kjv: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
verses.modern: And why not do evil so that good may come — as some slander us by saying that we preach? Their damnation is just.

verses.kjv: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
verses.modern: What then? Are we Jews any better off? No, not at all. We have already charged that both Jews and Greeks are all under sin,

verses.kjv: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
verses.modern: as it is written: "There is no one righteous, not even one.

verses.kjv: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
verses.modern: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

verses.kjv: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.modern: All have turned away. Together they have become worthless. There is no one who does good — not even one."

verses.kjv: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
verses.modern: "Their throat is an open grave. With their tongues they have practiced deceit. The poison of asps is under their lips."

verses.kjv: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
verses.modern: "Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness."

verses.kjv: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
verses.modern: "Their feet are swift to shed blood."

verses.kjv: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
verses.modern: "Ruin and misery are in their paths."

verses.kjv: And the way of peace have they not known:
verses.modern: "The way of peace they have not known."

verses.kjv: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
verses.modern: "There is no fear of God before their eyes."

verses.kjv: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
verses.modern: Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God.

verses.kjv: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
verses.modern: Therefore no flesh will be justified in His sight by works of the law, for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

verses.kjv: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
verses.modern: But now the righteousness of God has been revealed apart from the law, though the law and the prophets testify to it.

verses.kjv: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
verses.modern: This righteousness of God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no distinction,

verses.kjv: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
verses.modern: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.

verses.kjv: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
verses.modern: They are justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
verses.modern: God set Him forth to be a propitiation through faith in His blood, to declare His righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God.

verses.kjv: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
verses.modern: He did this to demonstrate His righteousness at the present time — that He is just and the one who justifies the person who has faith in Jesus.

verses.kjv: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
verses.modern: Where, then, is boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? By a law of works? No, but by the law of faith.

verses.kjv: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
verses.modern: We conclude that a person is justified by faith apart from works of the law.

verses.kjv: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
verses.modern: Or is God the God of Jews only? Is He not also the God of Gentiles? Yes, of Gentiles also—

verses.kjv: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
verses.modern: since God is one. He will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.

verses.kjv: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
verses.modern: Do we then overthrow the law by this faith? Not at all! On the contrary, we uphold the law.

chapters.summary: Paul concludes that all people — Jew and Gentile — are under sin and that no flesh is justified by the deeds of the law. The righteousness of God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe, and God set forth Christ as a propitiation through His blood.

verses.kjv: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
verses.modern: What then shall we say was gained by Abraham, our forefather according to the flesh?

verses.kjv: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
verses.modern: If Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about — but not before God.

verses.kjv: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
verses.modern: What does the scripture say? "Abraham believed God, and it was counted to Him as righteousness."

verses.kjv: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
verses.modern: Now to one who works, his wages are not counted as a gift but as something owed.

verses.kjv: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
verses.modern: But to one who does not work but believes in Him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is counted as righteousness.

verses.kjv: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
verses.modern: David also describes the blessedness of the man to whom God imputes righteousness apart from works:

verses.kjv: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
verses.modern: "Blessed are those whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
verses.modern: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin."

verses.kjv: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.modern: Is this blessing only for the circumcised, or also for the uncircumcised? We say that faith was counted to Abraham as righteousness.

verses.kjv: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
verses.modern: How then was it counted? Was it before or after he was circumcised? It was not after but before he was circumcised.

verses.kjv: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
verses.modern: He received the sign of circumcision as a seal of the righteousness that he had by faith while still uncircumcised. The purpose was to make him the father of all who believe without being circumcised, so that righteousness might be imputed to them also.

verses.kjv: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
verses.modern: He is also the father of the circumcised who are not merely circumcised but who also walk in the footsteps of the faith that our father Abraham had before he was circumcised.

verses.kjv: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.modern: The promise to Abraham and his seed that he would inherit the world did not come through the law but through the righteousness of faith.

verses.kjv: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
verses.modern: If it is those who follow the law who are heirs, then faith is useless and the promise is nullified.

verses.kjv: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
verses.modern: For the law brings wrath, but where there is no law there is no transgression.

verses.kjv: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
verses.modern: Therefore the promise comes by faith so that it may rest on grace, and be guaranteed to all Abraham's seed — not only to those under the law but also to those who share Abraham's faith, for he is the father of us all—

verses.kjv: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
verses.modern: as it is written: "I have made you a father of many nations." He is our father in the sight of God, in whom He believed — the God Who quickens the dead and calls into existence things that do not exist.

verses.kjv: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
verses.modern: Against all hope, Abraham in hope believed and so became the father of many nations, just as it had been said to him: "So shall your seed be."

verses.kjv: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:
verses.modern: He did not weaken in faith when he considered his own body, which was as good as dead (he was about a hundred years old), or when he considered the deadness of Sarah's womb.

verses.kjv: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
verses.modern: He did not waver in unbelief regarding the promise of God, but grew strong in faith, giving glory to God.

verses.kjv: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
verses.modern: He was fully convinced that God was able to do what He had promised.

verses.kjv: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
verses.modern: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.

verses.kjv: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
verses.modern: Now it was not written for his sake alone that it was imputed to him,

verses.kjv: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
verses.modern: but for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe in Him who raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead —

verses.kjv: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
verses.modern: He was delivered over for our sins and raised for our justification.

chapters.summary: Paul argues that Abraham was justified by faith, not works, and that his faith was counted to him for righteousness before he was circumcised. The promise came through the righteousness of faith so that it might be by grace and be sure to all the seed — not to those of the law only, but to all who share Abraham's faith.

verses.kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.modern: Therefore, having been justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.modern: Through Him we have also obtained access by faith into this grace in which we stand, and we rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

verses.kjv: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
verses.modern: Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces endurance,

verses.kjv: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
verses.modern: and endurance produces character, and character produces hope.

verses.kjv: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
verses.modern: This hope does not disappoint us, because the love of God has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Ghost Who has been given to us.

verses.kjv: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.modern: While we were still weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

verses.kjv: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
verses.modern: Rarely will anyone die for a righteous man, though perhaps for a good man someone might dare to die.

verses.kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.modern: But God shows His love for us in this: while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

verses.kjv: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
verses.modern: Since we have now been justified by His blood, how much more shall we be saved from God's wrath through Him!

verses.kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
verses.modern: If, while we were God's enemies, we were reconciled to Him through the death of His Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through His life!

verses.kjv: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
verses.modern: Not only that, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the atonement.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
verses.modern: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man and death through sin, so death spread to all men, because all sinned.

verses.kjv: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
verses.modern: Sin was in the world before the law was given, but sin is not counted against someone when there is no law.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
verses.modern: Yet death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over those who did not sin after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who was a figure of the One to come.

verses.kjv: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
verses.modern: But the free gift is not like the transgression. For if many died through one man's sin, how much more has the grace of God and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, overflowed to the many!

verses.kjv: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
verses.modern: The gift is not like the result of one man's sin. The judgment following one sin brought condemnation, but the free gift following many transgressions brought justification.

verses.kjv: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
verses.modern: If, because of one man's sin, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and the free gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ!

verses.kjv: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
verses.modern: Just as one trespass led to condemnation for all men, so one act of righteousness leads to justification and life for all men.

verses.kjv: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
verses.modern: Just as through the disobedience of one man the many were made sinners, so through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.

verses.kjv: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
verses.modern: The law came in so that the transgression would increase. But where sin increased, grace increased all the more,

verses.kjv: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.modern: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness leading to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

chapters.summary: Paul declares that being justified by faith brings peace with God and access to His grace. He argues that as sin and death entered the world through Adam, much more does the free gift of righteousness and life abound through Jesus Christ to all who receive it.

verses.kjv: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
verses.modern: What shall we say then? Should we go on sinning so that grace may increase?

verses.kjv: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
verses.modern: Not at all! We who died to sin — how can we live in it any longer?

verses.kjv: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?
verses.modern: Do You not know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death?

verses.kjv: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
verses.modern: We were therefore buried with Him through baptism into death, so that, just as Christ was raised from the dead by the glory of the Father, we too might walk in newness of life.

verses.kjv: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
verses.modern: If we have been united with Him in a death like His, we will certainly also be united with Him in a resurrection like His.

verses.kjv: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
verses.modern: We know that our old self was crucified with Him so that the body of sin might be destroyed, and we might no longer be slaves to sin.

verses.kjv: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
verses.modern: For one who has died has been set free from sin.

verses.kjv: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
verses.modern: Now if we have died with Christ, we believe we will also live with Him.

verses.kjv: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.
verses.modern: We know that Christ, having been raised from the dead, will never die again. Death no longer has dominion over Him.

verses.kjv: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
verses.modern: The death He died, He died to sin once for all. The life He lives, He lives to God.

verses.kjv: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.modern: In the same way, count yourselves dead to sin but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
verses.modern: Do not let sin reign in Your mortal body so that You obey its evil desires.

verses.kjv: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.
verses.modern: Do not offer the members of Your body to sin as instruments of unrighteousness. Instead, offer yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life, and offer the members of Your body to Him as instruments of righteousness.

verses.kjv: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
verses.modern: Sin shall not have dominion over You, for You are not under the law but under grace.

verses.kjv: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
verses.modern: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under the law but under grace? Not at all!

verses.kjv: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
verses.modern: Do You not know that if You present yourselves to someone as obedient servants, you are the servants of the one You obey — whether of sin leading to death, or of obedience leading to righteousness?

verses.kjv: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
verses.modern: But thanks be to God that, though You were once servants of sin, You have wholeheartedly obeyed the pattern of teaching to which You were entrusted.

verses.kjv: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
verses.modern: Having been set free from sin, You have become servants of righteousness.

verses.kjv: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
verses.modern: I am speaking in human terms because of Your natural limitations. Just as You once offered Your members as servants to impurity and iniquity, leading to more iniquity — now offer them as servants to righteousness, leading to holiness.

verses.kjv: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.
verses.modern: When You were servants of sin, You were free from the control of righteousness.

verses.kjv: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
verses.modern: What benefit did You gain from the things You are now ashamed of? The end of those things is death.

verses.kjv: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
verses.modern: But now that You have been set free from sin and have become servants of God, the benefit You reap leads to holiness, and the end result is everlasting life.

verses.kjv: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.modern: The wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

chapters.summary: Paul argues that believers who have been baptized into Christ's death must not continue in sin, because they have died to sin and are alive to God. He instructs them to yield their members as instruments of righteousness, for sin shall not have dominion over those who are under grace, not the law.

verses.kjv: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
verses.modern: Do You not know, brothers — for I am speaking to those who know the law — that the law has authority over a person only as long as He lives?

verses.kjv: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
verses.modern: A married woman is bound by law to her husband as long as He lives. But if her husband dies, she is released from the law of marriage.

verses.kjv: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
verses.modern: So if she joins with another man while her husband is living, she will be called an adulteress. But if her husband dies, she is free from that law and is not an adulteress if she marries another man.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
verses.modern: Likewise, my brothers, You also have died to the law through the body of Christ, so that You may belong to another — to Him who was raised from the dead — that we might bear fruit for God.

verses.kjv: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
verses.modern: When we were in the flesh, the sinful passions aroused by the law were at work in our members to bear fruit for death.

verses.kjv: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
verses.modern: But now we have been released from the law, having died to that which held us captive, so that we serve in the new way of the Spirit and not in the old way of the written code.

verses.kjv: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
verses.modern: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? Not at all! I would not have known sin except through the law. I would not have known what it was to covet if the law had not said, "You shall not covet."

verses.kjv: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
verses.modern: But sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, produced in me every kind of covetousness. Apart from the law, sin is dead.

verses.kjv: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
verses.modern: I was once alive apart from the law, but when the commandment came, sin sprang to life and I died.

verses.kjv: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
verses.modern: The very commandment that was meant to bring life proved to bring death to me.

verses.kjv: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.
verses.modern: Sin, seizing the opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through it killed me.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
verses.modern: So the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous, and good.

verses.kjv: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
verses.modern: Did that which is good, then, bring death to me? Not at all! It was sin, producing death in me through what is good, so that sin might be shown to be sin, and through the commandment might become extremely sinful.

verses.kjv: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
verses.modern: We know that the law is spiritual. But I am fleshly, sold under sin.

verses.kjv: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
verses.modern: I do not understand what I am doing. I do not do what I want to do, but I do what I hate.

verses.kjv: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
verses.modern: If I do what I do not want to do, I agree that the law is good.

verses.kjv: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.modern: So it is no longer I who do it, but sin that lives in me.

verses.kjv: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
verses.modern: I know that nothing good lives in me — that is, in my flesh. The desire to do good is present in me, but I cannot carry it out.

verses.kjv: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
verses.modern: I do not do the good I want to do, but the evil I do not want to do — I keep on doing it.

verses.kjv: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.modern: If I do what I do not want to do, it is no longer I who do it, but sin living in me that does it.

verses.kjv: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
verses.modern: So I find this law at work: whenever I want to do good, evil is right there with me.

verses.kjv: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
verses.modern: I delight in the law of God in my inner being,

verses.kjv: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
verses.modern: but I see another law at work in my members, waging war against the law of my mind and taking me captive to the law of sin that is at work in my members.

verses.kjv: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
verses.modern: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me from this body of death?

verses.kjv: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
verses.modern: Thanks be to God — through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, with my mind I myself serve the law of God, but with my flesh I serve the law of sin.

chapters.summary: Paul explains that believers are dead to the law through the body of Christ, freed to serve in newness of spirit. He describes the inner struggle with sin: the law is holy and good, but sin dwelling in the flesh wages war against the mind, so that the good he would do he does not, and the evil he would not do he practices.

verses.kjv: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.modern: There is therefore now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus, Who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.

verses.kjv: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
verses.modern: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has set me free from the law of sin and death.

verses.kjv: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
verses.modern: For what the law could not do, because it was weakened by the flesh, God did by sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and as an offering for sin. He condemned sin in the flesh,

verses.kjv: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.modern: so that the righteous requirement of the law might be fulfilled in us, who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.

verses.kjv: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
verses.modern: Those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh. Those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.

verses.kjv: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
verses.modern: The mind set on the flesh is death, but the mind set on the Spirit is life and peace.

verses.kjv: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
verses.modern: The mind set on the flesh is hostile to God — it does not submit to God's law, nor can it do so.

verses.kjv: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
verses.modern: Those who are in the flesh cannot please God.

verses.kjv: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
verses.modern: You, however, are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if indeed the Spirit of God lives in You. But if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, He does not belong to Him.

verses.kjv: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
verses.modern: But if Christ is in You, then even though the body is dead because of sin, the Spirit gives life because of righteousness.

verses.kjv: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
verses.modern: If the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead lives in You, He who raised Christ from the dead will also quicken Your mortal bodies through His Spirit who lives in You.

verses.kjv: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
verses.modern: So then, brothers, we are not obligated to the flesh, to live according to the flesh.

verses.kjv: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
verses.modern: For if You live according to the flesh, You will die. But if by the Spirit You put to death the deeds of the body, You will live.

verses.kjv: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
verses.modern: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.

verses.kjv: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
verses.modern: You have not received a spirit of slavery to fall back into fear. You have received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, "Abba, Father."

verses.kjv: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
verses.modern: The Spirit Himself bears witness with our spirit that we are children of God.

verses.kjv: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
verses.modern: If we are children, then we are heirs — heirs of God and fellow heirs with Christ — if indeed we suffer with Him so that we may also be glorified with Him.

verses.kjv: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
verses.modern: I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worth comparing to the glory that will be revealed in us.

verses.kjv: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
verses.modern: For the eager longing of creation waits for the revealing of the sons of God.

verses.kjv: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
verses.modern: For the creation was subjected to frustration — not by its own choice but by the will of the One who subjected it — in hope

verses.kjv: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
verses.modern: that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to decay and brought into the glorious freedom of the children of God.

verses.kjv: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
verses.modern: We know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth up to the present time.

verses.kjv: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
verses.modern: Not only that, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for adoption — the redemption of our bodies.

verses.kjv: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
verses.modern: We are saved in hope. But hope that is seen is not hope — who hopes for what He already sees?

verses.kjv: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
verses.modern: But if we hope for what we do not see, we wait for it with patience.

verses.kjv: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
verses.modern: Likewise the Spirit helps us in our weakness. We do not know what we should pray for as we ought, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groanings too deep for words.

verses.kjv: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
verses.modern: He who searches the hearts knows what the Spirit's mind is, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.

verses.kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
verses.modern: We know that all things work together for good to those who love God, to those who are called according to His purpose.

verses.kjv: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
verses.modern: Those He foreknew He also predestined to be conformed to the image of His Son, so that He might be the firstborn among many brothers.

verses.kjv: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
verses.modern: Those He predestined He also called; those He called He also justified; those He justified He also glorified.

verses.kjv: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
verses.modern: What shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

verses.kjv: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
verses.modern: He who did not spare his own Son but delivered him up for us all — will He not also, along with Him, freely give us all things?

verses.kjv: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.
verses.modern: Who will bring any charge against God's elect? It is God Who justifies.

verses.kjv: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
verses.modern: Who is He that condemns? It is Christ Who died — more than that, who was raised to life — who is at the right hand of God and is also interceding for us.

verses.kjv: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.modern: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or danger, or sword?

verses.kjv: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.modern: As it is written: "For Your sake we are being killed all day long. We are counted as sheep to be slaughtered."

verses.kjv: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
verses.modern: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.

verses.kjv: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
verses.modern: I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor principalities, neither things present nor things to come,

verses.kjv: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.modern: neither height nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

chapters.summary: Paul declares that there is no condemnation for those in Christ Jesus who walk after the Spirit, and that the Spirit Himself bears witness with our spirit that we are the children of God. He argues that all things work together for good to those who love God, and that nothing — neither death, nor life, nor any creature — shall be able to separate us from the love of God in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
verses.modern: I am speaking the truth in Christ — I am not lying; my conscience confirms it in the Holy Ghost—

verses.kjv: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
verses.modern: that I have great sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.

verses.kjv: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
verses.modern: I could wish that I myself were cursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my brothers, my kinsmen according to the flesh.

verses.kjv: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
verses.modern: They are Israelites. To them belong the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the worship, and the promises.

verses.kjv: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.modern: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them, according to the flesh, came Christ, Who is God over all, blessed forever. Amen.

verses.kjv: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
verses.modern: It is not as though God's word has failed. Not all who are descended from Israel are Israel.

verses.kjv: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.modern: Not all of Abraham's children are his true descendants, but "Through Isaac your seed will be named."

verses.kjv: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
verses.modern: This means it is not the children of the flesh who are God's children, but the children of the promise who are counted as the seed.

verses.kjv: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.
verses.modern: For this is the word of promise: "At this time I will come, and Sarah shall have a son."

verses.kjv: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
verses.modern: Not only that, but when Rebecca had conceived children by one man — our forefather Isaac—

verses.kjv: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
verses.modern: before the twins were born and had done anything good or bad — so that God's purpose in election would stand, not by works but by His call—

verses.kjv: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
verses.modern: she was told: "The older will serve the younger."

verses.kjv: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
verses.modern: As it is written: "Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated."

verses.kjv: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
verses.modern: What shall we say then? Is there injustice with God? Not at all!

verses.kjv: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
verses.modern: For He says to Moses: "I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion."

verses.kjv: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
verses.modern: So then, it does not depend on human will or effort, but on God Who shows mercy.

verses.kjv: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
verses.modern: The scripture says to Pharaoh: "I raised you up for this very purpose — to display My power in you, so that My name might be proclaimed throughout all the earth."

verses.kjv: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
verses.modern: So then, He has mercy on whom He will, and He hardens whom He will.

verses.kjv: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
verses.modern: You will say to me then, "Why does He still find fault? For who can resist His will?"

verses.kjv: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
verses.modern: But who are you, O man, to argue with God? Will what is molded say to the one who molds it, "Why have you made me like this?"

verses.kjv: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
verses.modern: Does not the potter have authority over the clay, to make from the same lump one vessel for honored use and another for common use?

verses.kjv: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
verses.modern: What if God, wanting to show His wrath and make His power known, bore with great longsuffering the vessels of wrath prepared for destruction—

verses.kjv: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
verses.modern: in order to make known the riches of His glory on vessels of mercy, which He had prepared beforehand for glory—

verses.kjv: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
verses.modern: even us whom He has called, not from the Jews only but also from the Gentiles?

verses.kjv: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
verses.modern: As He says in Hosea: "Those who were not My people I will call My people, and her who was not beloved I will call beloved."

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
verses.modern: "In the very place where it was said to them, 'You are not My people,' there they will be called children of the living God."

verses.kjv: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
verses.modern: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: "Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, only a remnant will be saved."

verses.kjv: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
verses.modern: "For the Lord will carry out His sentence on the earth completely and without delay."

verses.kjv: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
verses.modern: As Isaiah said previously: "If the Lord of Sabaoth had not left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom and been made like Gomorrah."

verses.kjv: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
verses.modern: What shall we say then? That Gentiles who did not pursue righteousness have attained it — the righteousness that is by faith.

verses.kjv: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
verses.modern: But Israel, who pursued a law of righteousness, has not attained it.

verses.kjv: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
verses.modern: Why not? Because they pursued it not by faith but as if it were by works. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,

verses.kjv: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
verses.modern: as it is written: "See, I am laying in Zion a stone that causes stumbling and a rock of offense. Whoever believes in him will not be put to shame."

chapters.summary: Paul expresses great sorrow for Israel and argues that God's word has not failed, because not all who are of Israel are truly Israel. He defends God's sovereign right to show mercy on whom He will and to harden whom He will, as the potter has power over the clay.

verses.kjv: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
verses.modern: Brothers, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is that they might be saved.

verses.kjv: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
verses.modern: I testify on their behalf that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

verses.kjv: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
verses.modern: For being ignorant of God's righteousness and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they have not submitted to God's righteousness.

verses.kjv: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
verses.modern: Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

verses.kjv: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
verses.modern: Moses writes about the righteousness that is based on the law: "The person who does these things will live by them."

verses.kjv: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
verses.modern: But the righteousness based on faith says: "Do not say in Your heart, 'Who will ascend into heaven?'" — that is, to bring Christ down—

verses.kjv: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
verses.modern: or "Who will descend into the deep?" — that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.

verses.kjv: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
verses.modern: But what does it say? "The word is near You, in Your mouth and in Your heart" — that is, the word of faith that we preach.

verses.kjv: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
verses.modern: If You confess with Your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in Your heart that God raised Him from the dead, You will be saved.

verses.kjv: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
verses.modern: With the heart one believes and is justified, and with the mouth one confesses and is saved.

verses.kjv: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
verses.modern: The scripture says: "Whosoever believes in him will not be put to shame."

verses.kjv: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
verses.modern: There is no distinction between Jew and Greek, for the same Lord is Lord of all and bestows His riches on all who call on Him.

verses.kjv: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.modern: "For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved."

verses.kjv: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
verses.modern: How then shall they call on Him in whom they have not believed? How shall they believe in Him of whom they have not heard? How shall they hear without someone preaching?

verses.kjv: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
verses.modern: How shall they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: "How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the gospel of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!"

verses.kjv: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
verses.modern: But not all have obeyed the gospel. For Isaiah says: "Lord, who has believed our message?"

verses.kjv: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verses.modern: So then faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

verses.kjv: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
verses.modern: But I ask: Have they not heard? Yes, certainly: "Their voice has gone out to all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world."

verses.kjv: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
verses.modern: But I ask: Did not Israel know? First, Moses says: "I will provoke you to jealousy by those who are not a nation. By a foolish nation I will make you angry."

verses.kjv: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
verses.modern: Then Isaiah boldly says: "I was found by those who did not seek Me. I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me."

verses.kjv: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
verses.modern: But to Israel He says: "All day long I have held out My hands to a disobedient and argumentative people."

chapters.summary: Paul declares that Israel has a zeal for God but not according to knowledge, seeking to establish their own righteousness rather than submitting to the righteousness of God. He proclaims that whoever calls on the name of the Lord shall be saved, and that faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

verses.kjv: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.modern: I ask then: has God rejected his people? Not at all! I myself am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.kjv: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,
verses.modern: God has not rejected His people whom He foreknew. Do you not know what the scripture says about Elijah — how he pleaded with God against Israel?

verses.kjv: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
verses.modern: "Lord, they have killed Your prophets and torn down Your altars. I am the only one left, and they are trying to kill me."

verses.kjv: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
verses.modern: But what was God's answer to Him? "I have reserved for Myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal."

verses.kjv: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
verses.modern: So too, at the present time, there is a remnant chosen by grace.

verses.kjv: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
verses.modern: And if it is by grace, it is no longer by works — otherwise grace would no longer be grace.

verses.kjv: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded
verses.modern: What then? What Israel was seeking, it did not obtain, but the elect did obtain it. The others were hardened,

verses.kjv: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
verses.modern: as it is written: "God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that would not see and ears that would not hear, to this very day."

verses.kjv: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
verses.modern: David says: "Let their table become a snare and a trap, a stumbling block and a retribution to them.

verses.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
verses.modern: Let their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and make their backs bend forever."

verses.kjv: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
verses.modern: I ask then: did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? Not at all! Rather, through their transgression, salvation has come to the Gentiles, to make Israel jealous.

verses.kjv: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
verses.modern: Now if their transgression brings riches to the world, and their failure brings riches to the Gentiles, how much more will their fullness bring!

verses.kjv: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
verses.modern: I am speaking to you Gentiles. Since I am the apostle to the Gentiles, I make the most of my ministry,

verses.kjv: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
verses.modern: in the hope that I may somehow arouse my own people to jealousy and save some of them.

verses.kjv: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
verses.modern: For if their rejection brought reconciliation to the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?

verses.kjv: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
verses.modern: If the firstfruits are holy, the whole batch is holy. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

verses.kjv: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
verses.modern: If some of the branches were broken off, and you — a wild olive shoot — were grafted in among them to share in the richness of the olive root,

verses.kjv: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
verses.modern: do not boast over those branches. If you do boast, remember that it is not you who supports the root, but the root that supports you.

verses.kjv: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
verses.modern: You will say then, "Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in."
