verses.kjv: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
verses.modern: True. They were broken off because of unbelief, and you stand by faith. Do not be arrogant, but be afraid.

verses.kjv: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
verses.modern: For if God did not spare the natural branches, He will not spare you either.

verses.kjv: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
verses.modern: Consider therefore the goodness and severity of God — severity toward those who fell, but goodness toward you, if you continue in His goodness. Otherwise you too will be cut off.

verses.kjv: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
verses.modern: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

verses.kjv: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
verses.modern: After all, if you were cut from what is by nature a wild olive tree and grafted, contrary to nature, into a cultivated olive tree, how much more easily will these natural branches be grafted back into their own olive tree!

verses.kjv: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
verses.modern: I do not want you to be unaware of this mystery, brothers, so that you may not be conceited: a partial hardening has come upon Israel until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in.

verses.kjv: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
verses.modern: Then all Israel will be saved, as it is written: "The Deliverer will come from Zion. He will turn godlessness away from Jacob.

verses.kjv: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
verses.modern: This is My covenant with them when I take away their sins."

verses.kjv: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.
verses.modern: As regards the gospel, they are enemies for your sake. But as regards election, they are beloved for the sake of the patriarchs.

verses.kjv: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
verses.modern: For the gifts and the calling of God are without repentance.

verses.kjv: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
verses.modern: Just as you were once disobedient to God but have now received mercy because of their disobedience,

verses.kjv: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
verses.modern: so they too have now been disobedient in order that, by the mercy shown to you, they also may now receive mercy.

verses.kjv: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
verses.modern: For God has confined all men in disobedience so that He may show mercy to all.

verses.kjv: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
verses.modern: Oh, the depth of the riches and wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and how inscrutable His ways!

verses.kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
verses.modern: "For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been His adviser?"

verses.kjv: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
verses.modern: "Or who has given a gift to Him that He should be repaid?"

verses.kjv: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
verses.modern: For from Him and through Him and to Him are all things. To Him be the glory forever. Amen.

chapters.summary: Paul argues that God has not cast away Israel, for a remnant according to the election of grace remains. He uses the olive tree to illustrate how Gentile branches were grafted in and warns them not to boast, declaring that blindness in part has happened to Israel until the fulness of the Gentiles comes in, and so all Israel shall be saved.

verses.kjv: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
verses.modern: I urge You, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present Your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to God — which is Your reasonable service.

verses.kjv: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
verses.modern: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of Your mind, so that You may discern what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.

verses.kjv: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
verses.modern: By the grace given to me, I say to every one of you: do not think of yourself more highly than You ought, but think with sober judgment, each according to the measure of faith God has given You.

verses.kjv: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
verses.modern: Just as we have many members in one body and these members do not all have the same function,

verses.kjv: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
verses.modern: so we who are many are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another.

verses.kjv: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
verses.modern: We have different gifts according to the grace given to us. If prophecy — use it in proportion to Your faith.

verses.kjv: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
verses.modern: If serving — serve. If teaching — teach.

verses.kjv: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
verses.modern: If encouraging — encourage. If giving — give generously. If leading — lead with diligence. If showing mercy — do it cheerfully.

verses.kjv: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
verses.modern: Let love be sincere. Hate what is evil; hold fast to what is good.

verses.kjv: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
verses.modern: Love one another with brotherly affection. In honor, put others before yourselves.

verses.kjv: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
verses.modern: Do not be lazy, but be fervent in spirit. Serve the Lord.

verses.kjv: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
verses.modern: Rejoice in hope, be patient in tribulation, and be constant in prayer.

verses.kjv: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
verses.modern: Share with the Lord's people who are in need. Practice hospitality.

verses.kjv: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
verses.modern: Bless those who persecute You — bless and do not curse.

verses.kjv: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
verses.modern: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.

verses.kjv: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
verses.modern: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but be willing to associate with people of low position. Do not be conceited.

verses.kjv: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
verses.modern: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Do what is right in the eyes of everyone.

verses.kjv: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
verses.modern: If it is possible, as far as it depends on You, live at peace with everyone.

verses.kjv: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
verses.modern: Do not take revenge, my dear friends, but leave room for God's wrath. "Vengeance is Mine; I will repay, says the Lord."

verses.kjv: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
verses.modern: "If Your enemy is hungry, feed Him. If He is thirsty, give Him a drink. In doing so, You will heap burning coals on His head."

verses.kjv: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.modern: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

chapters.summary: Paul urges believers to present their bodies as a living sacrifice and to be transformed by the renewing of their minds. He instructs them on the use of spiritual gifts within the body of Christ and on practical duties: love without hypocrisy, patience in tribulation, hospitality, and overcoming evil with good.

verses.kjv: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
verses.modern: Let every person be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those that exist have been established by God.

verses.kjv: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
verses.modern: Therefore whoever resists the authority resists what God has ordained, and those who resist will bring damnation on themselves.

verses.kjv: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
verses.modern: For rulers are not a terror to good conduct, but to bad. Do you want to be free from fear of the one in authority? Do what is good and you will have his approval.

verses.kjv: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
verses.modern: For he is God's servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid — He does not carry the sword for nothing. He is God's servant, an agent of wrath to bring punishment on the wrongdoer.

verses.kjv: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
verses.modern: Therefore it is necessary to be in submission, not only to avoid God's wrath but also for the sake of conscience.

verses.kjv: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
verses.modern: This is also why you pay taxes, for the authorities are God's servants, devoting themselves to this very thing.

verses.kjv: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
verses.modern: Pay to all what is owed to them: taxes to whom taxes are owed, revenue to whom revenue is owed, respect to whom respect is owed, honor to whom honor is owed.

verses.kjv: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
verses.modern: Owe no one anything except to love one another, for the one who loves another has fulfilled the law.

verses.kjv: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
verses.modern: The commandments — you shall not commit adultery, you shall not kill, you shall not steal, you shall not bear false witness, you shall not covet — and any other commandment are summed up in this one rule: "Love your neighbor as yourself."

verses.kjv: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
verses.modern: Love does no harm to a neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.

verses.kjv: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
verses.modern: Do this, knowing the time — that the hour has come for you to wake from sleep, for our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.

verses.kjv: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
verses.modern: The night is almost over; the day is near. So let us put aside the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.

verses.kjv: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
verses.modern: Let us behave properly, as in the daytime — not in carousing and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and sensuality, not in strife and jealousy.

verses.kjv: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
verses.modern: Instead, clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no plans to gratify the desires of the flesh.

chapters.summary: Paul instructs believers to submit to governing authorities, for the powers that be are ordained of God, and whoever resists the authority resists the ordinance of God. He summarizes the law in the command to love one's neighbor and urges the church to put on the armour of light, for salvation is nearer than when they first believed.

verses.kjv: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
verses.modern: Accept the one who is weak in faith, but do not quarrel over opinions.

verses.kjv: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
verses.modern: One person believes He may eat anything, while the weak person eats only vegetables.

verses.kjv: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
verses.modern: Let not the one who eats despise the one who does not, and let not the one who does not eat judge the one who does, for God has accepted Him.

verses.kjv: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
verses.modern: Who are You to judge someone else's servant? To his own master he stands or falls. And He will stand, for the Lord is able to make Him stand.

verses.kjv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
verses.modern: One person considers one day more sacred than another; another considers every day alike. Each one should be fully convinced in his own mind.

verses.kjv: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
verses.modern: Whoever observes the day, observes it to the Lord. Whoever eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives thanks to God. Whoever does not eat, abstains to the Lord and gives thanks to God.

verses.kjv: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
verses.modern: For none of us lives to Himself, and none of us dies to Himself.

verses.kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.
verses.modern: If we live, we live to the Lord; if we die, we die to the Lord. Whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.

verses.kjv: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
verses.modern: For this very reason Christ died and came back to life — that He might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

verses.kjv: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
verses.modern: Why then do You judge Your brother? Or why do You look down on Your brother? For we will all stand before God's judgment seat.

verses.kjv: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
verses.modern: As it is written: "As I live, says the Lord, every knee will bow to Me, and every tongue will confess to God."

verses.kjv: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
verses.modern: So then, each of us will give an account of himself to God.

verses.kjv: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.
verses.modern: Let us therefore stop judging one another. Instead, make up Your mind not to put a stumbling block or obstacle in Your brother's way.

verses.kjv: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
verses.modern: I am convinced, as one who is in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean in itself. But to the one who considers something to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

verses.kjv: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
verses.modern: If Your brother is grieved because of what You eat, You are no longer walking charitably. Do not destroy by Your food the one for whom Christ died.

verses.kjv: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
verses.modern: Do not let what You consider good to be spoken of as evil.

verses.kjv: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
verses.modern: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

verses.kjv: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
verses.modern: Whoever serves Christ in this way is pleasing to God and approved by men.

verses.kjv: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
verses.modern: So then, let us pursue what makes for peace and what builds one another up.

verses.kjv: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
verses.modern: Do not destroy the work of God for the sake of food. All food is clean, but it is wrong for anyone to eat in a way that causes someone else to stumble.

verses.kjv: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
verses.modern: It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that will cause Your brother to stumble or be offended or made weak.

verses.kjv: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
verses.modern: The faith that You have, keep between Yourself and God. Blessed is the one who does not condemn himself by what he approves.

verses.kjv: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
verses.modern: But whoever doubts is damned if he eats, because the eating is not from faith — and everything that does not come from faith is sin.

chapters.summary: Paul instructs believers to receive the weak in faith without passing judgment on disputable matters such as eating and observing days. He argues that every person shall give account of himself to God, and that the kingdom of God is not about food and drink but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

verses.kjv: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
verses.modern: We who are strong ought to bear with the failings of the weak and not to please ourselves.

verses.kjv: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
verses.modern: Each of us should please his neighbor for his good, to build Him up.

verses.kjv: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
verses.modern: For even Christ did not please Himself, but as it is written: "The reproaches of those who reproached You fell on Me."

verses.kjv: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
verses.modern: For whatever was written in former days was written for our instruction, so that through the endurance and encouragement of the scriptures we might have hope.

verses.kjv: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
verses.modern: May the God of endurance and encouragement grant You to be of one mind with one another, in keeping with Christ Jesus,

verses.kjv: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.modern: so that together You may with one voice glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
verses.modern: Therefore accept one another, just as Christ also accepted us, to the glory of God.

verses.kjv: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
verses.modern: I tell You that Christ became a servant to the circumcised to show God's truthfulness — to confirm the promises given to the patriarchs—

verses.kjv: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
verses.modern: and in order that the Gentiles might glorify God for His mercy. As it is written: "Therefore I will praise You among the Gentiles, and sing to Your name."

verses.kjv: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
verses.modern: Again it says: "Rejoice, You Gentiles, together with His people."

verses.kjv: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
verses.modern: And again: "Praise the Lord, all You Gentiles, and let all the peoples praise Him."

verses.kjv: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
verses.modern: And again Isaiah says: "The Root of Jesse will come — He who rises to rule the Gentiles. In him the Gentiles will hope."

verses.kjv: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
verses.modern: May the God of hope fill You with all joy and peace in believing, so that by the power of the Holy Ghost You may overflow with hope.

verses.kjv: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
verses.modern: I myself am satisfied about You, my brothers, that You yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, and able to instruct one another.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
verses.modern: But I have written to You rather boldly on some points, as a reminder to You, because of the grace God gave me

verses.kjv: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
verses.modern: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest in the gospel of God, so that the offering of the Gentiles might be acceptable — sanctified by the Holy Ghost.

verses.kjv: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
verses.modern: I have reason to boast in Christ Jesus about the things that pertain to God.

verses.kjv: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
verses.modern: I will not venture to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me to bring the Gentiles to obedience — by word and deed,

verses.kjv: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
verses.modern: by the power of signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God — so that from Jerusalem and all the way around to Illyricum I have fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ.

verses.kjv: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:
verses.modern: Thus I make it my ambition to preach the gospel where Christ has not already been named, rather than building on someone else's foundation.

verses.kjv: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see; and they that have not heard shall understand.
verses.modern: As it is written: "Those who have never been told about Him will see, and those who have never heard will understand."

verses.kjv: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
verses.modern: This is why I have been so often hindered from coming to You.

verses.kjv: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
verses.modern: But now, with no more room for work in these regions, and having longed for many years to come to You,

verses.kjv: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
verses.modern: I hope to see You in passing as I travel to Spain. I hope to enjoy Your company for a while and then to have You assist me on my journey there.

verses.kjv: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
verses.modern: For now, I am going to Jerusalem to serve the saints.

verses.kjv: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
verses.modern: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
verses.modern: They were pleased to do this, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in the Jews' spiritual blessings, they owe it to the Jews to share with them their material blessings.

verses.kjv: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
verses.modern: When I have completed this and have delivered this contribution securely to them, I will come to You on my way to Spain.

verses.kjv: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
verses.modern: I know that when I come to You, I will come with the full blessing of the gospel of Christ.

verses.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
verses.modern: I urge You, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to join me in earnest prayer to God on my behalf.

verses.kjv: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
verses.modern: Pray that I may be delivered from those in Judea who do not believe, and that my service for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

verses.kjv: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
verses.modern: so that by God's will I may come to You with joy and be refreshed together with You.

verses.kjv: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.modern: May the God of peace be with You all. Amen.

chapters.summary: Paul urges the strong to bear with the weak and to follow Christ's example of selflessness, declaring that Christ became a minister to the Jews and that the Gentiles might glorify God for His mercy. He shares his ambition to preach where Christ has not been named and outlines his plans to visit Rome on his way to Spain.

verses.kjv: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
verses.modern: I commend to You our sister Phoebe, a servant of the church at Cenchrea.

verses.kjv: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
verses.modern: Receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and help her with whatever she needs from You, for she has been a great help to many people, including me.

verses.kjv: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
verses.modern: Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my co-workers in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
verses.modern: They risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks but also all the churches of the Gentiles.

verses.kjv: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
verses.modern: Greet also the church that meets in their home. Greet my beloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.

verses.kjv: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
verses.modern: Greet Mary, who worked very hard for you.

verses.kjv: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
verses.modern: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen and my fellow prisoners. They are well known among the apostles and were in Christ before me.

verses.kjv: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
verses.modern: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

verses.kjv: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
verses.modern: Greet Urbanus, our co-worker in Christ, and my beloved Stachys.

verses.kjv: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.
verses.modern: Greet Apelles, who is approved in Christ. Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus.

verses.kjv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
verses.modern: Greet my kinsman Herodion. Greet those in the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.

verses.kjv: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
verses.modern: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, who work hard in the Lord. Greet the beloved Persis, who has worked very hard in the Lord.

verses.kjv: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
verses.modern: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and His mother, who has been a mother to me too.

verses.kjv: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
verses.modern: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brothers with them.

verses.kjv: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
verses.modern: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and His sister, and Olympas, and all the saints with them.

verses.kjv: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
verses.modern: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ greet You.

verses.kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
verses.modern: I urge You, brothers, to watch out for those who cause divisions and create obstacles contrary to the teaching You have learned. Avoid them.

verses.kjv: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
verses.modern: For such people do not serve our Lord Jesus Christ but their own belly. By good words and fair speeches they deceive the hearts of the simple.

verses.kjv: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
verses.modern: Your obedience is known to all, and I rejoice over You. But I want You to be wise about what is good and innocent about what is evil.

verses.kjv: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verses.modern: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with You.

verses.kjv: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
verses.modern: Timothy, my co-worker, greets you. So do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen.

verses.kjv: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
verses.modern: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.

verses.kjv: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
verses.modern: Gaius, who is host to me and to the whole church, greets you. Erastus, the city treasurer, greets you, and so does our brother Quartus.

verses.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.modern: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with You all. Amen.

verses.kjv: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
verses.modern: Now to Him who is able to strengthen You according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ — according to the revelation of the mystery that was kept hidden for ages past—

verses.kjv: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
verses.modern: but is now disclosed and made known through the prophetic writings, by the command of the eternal God, to bring about obedience of faith among all nations—

verses.kjv: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
verses.modern: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, be glory forever. Amen.

chapters.summary: Paul commends Phoebe to the church and greets many believers by name, including Priscilla and Aquila who risked their own necks for his life. He warns them to mark those who cause divisions contrary to the doctrine they have learned and closes with a doxology to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ.
